allowed_closeout.scope: One bounded CPU-only scene-mean-L1 diagnostic using the same accepted1624, no new data. Freeze specification here before fitting.
allowed_closeout.primary_summary: g=mean(log(d2)) over all406 cells of a scene, aligned to the previous log-L1 feature; one scalar only.
allowed_closeout.literal_mean_sensitivity: g=log(mean(sqrt(d2))) over all406 cells: arithmetic mean guided RMS divergence followed by log. No sigma weighting. Report both, do not choose by held-out outcomes.
allowed_closeout.model: For each action, use the original exact target/age baseline in log loss. Fit one scalar ridge slope across TRAINING SCENES between centered g and each scene's mean log-loss residual. Apply one constant log offset to every held-out cell; no time/age interaction in the adjustment.
allowed_closeout.outer_and_inner: Same four outer scene-held-out folds, with nested leave-one-of-three-training-scenes-out selection among original lambdas [0,.01,.1,1,10,100] and no-signal. All fitting and scaling train-only.
allowed_closeout.metric: Primary C mean squared log error, all folds and scene-equal aggregate. Recovery=(baseline_loss-scene_only_loss)/(baseline_loss-previous_cellwise_L1_loss). This is predictive loss recovery, not explained variance or causal attribution.
allowed_closeout.additional_read_only_decomposition: For previous baseline and cellwise L1 predictions, log-error MSE = squared mean residual + centered residual MSE within each scene. Report the exact additive reduction of these terms and the teacher-label-derived best constant-offset oracle; oracle is diagnostic only.
allowed_closeout.online_validity: Uses complete future teacher-conditioned source alternatives; neither an online gate nor a demonstrated deployable budget predictor.
allowed_closeout.stop: After this report, no additional variants, feature collection, scheduler training, or L2/L3 work on this line.

mainline: PG-P1/P2 retain their existing exact scope, source, budgets, schedule, and verification. This closure adds no task or action to them.
future_diagnostic_design: Determine the oracle gap on CAL/pilot material first, then freeze a threshold expressed as a fraction of that gap before looking at held-out outcomes. If the gap is near zero, mark the diagnostic as unable to distinguish practical improvements. Retain absolute effect sizes and decision cost.
